name: Kakimoto Tooru
source:
A capable man who represents Osaka and has experience as a TV personality.
As one would expect of a celebrity, he is popular and maintains high approval ratings.
Although he is known as a passionate man, he actually acts based on cool, calculated judgment and is flawless in his execution.
However, his desire to restore Osaka’s finances is genuine, and he is prepared to stop at nothing to achieve that goal.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110528010142/http://www.turumiku.jp/osaka/kakimoto.html]official site[/url]]
